name: map-chart
purpose: Values by place on the dotted world map of `NetworkMap`: countries shaded on a five-step sequential scale (a choropleth on the dot grid) and locations drawn as bubbles whose area follows the value. One tab stop walks every place from the highest value down, with a tooltip, a polite announcement and a table twin, so nothing on the map needs a pointer. The country shapes are a lazy chunk; the map itself adds no dependency.
useWhen: Requests, threats or bandwidth by country (Real-Time Metrics map card).
Traffic by point of presence or by city, as bubbles.
A regional view of either, framed with `view` (for example `south-america`).
avoidWhen: Ranking a handful of countries where the exact order matters → use `bar-list`; a map hides small countries.
A decorative network backdrop with no data → use `network-map`.
related: network-map` — the same dot grid as decoration in marketing and empty states.
bar-list` — the ranked list that usually sits beside the map.
chart-card` — the card a dashboard map sits in; the map takes its accessible name from the card title.
bestPractices: Pair the map with a ranked list or a table: the map shows where, the list shows how much.
Pass ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes as region ids; names come from the locale (`Intl.DisplayNames`) unless you pass `name`.
Keep region and point ids distinct: `v-model:activeId` holds one of them.
Give points a status color only when the color means a state; otherwise leave the series slot.

props.name: regions
props.doc: Countries shaded by value on a five-step sequential scale.

props.name: points
props.doc: Locations drawn as bubbles sized by value.

props.name: view
props.doc: Part of the world the map frames.

props.name: formatValue
props.doc: Formats values in the tooltip, legend and table.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Renders a Skeleton sized to the map and suppresses interaction.

props.name: refetching
props.doc: Holds the previous render at reduced opacity while new data loads.

props.name: error
props.doc: Error message; when set, a danger Alert replaces the map.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.doc: Title of the empty state shown when no region or point has a value. Empty uses the locale catalog (`No data available`).

props.name: emptyDescription
props.doc: Supporting line under the empty title: why the range is empty, or what to do next.

props.name: tableView
props.doc: Shows the data table in place of the map. The table is always present for assistive tech.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the map when it is not inside a ChartCard with a title.

events.name: region-click
events.notes: Click on a shaded country, or Enter / Space while it is active.

events.name: point-click
events.notes: Click on a bubble, or Enter / Space while it is active.

slots.name: empty-actions
slots.notes: Actions under the default EmptyState, such as a Clear filters button.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import MapChart from '@aziontech/webkit/map-chart'

  const regions = [
    { id: 'BR', value: 48200 },
    { id: 'US', value: 31600 },
    { id: 'DE', value: 18900 },
    { id: 'IN', value: 15400 },
    { id: 'JP', value: 9800 },
    { id: 'MX', value: 7600 },
    { id: 'ZA', value: 4100 },
    { id: 'AU', value: 3900 }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <MapChart
    :regions="regions"
    aria-label="Requests by country"
  />
</template>

examples.name: View
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import MapChart from '@aziontech/webkit/map-chart'

  const regions = [
    { id: 'BR', value: 48200 },
    { id: 'AR', value: 9100 },
    { id: 'CO', value: 6800 },
    { id: 'CL', value: 5200 },
    { id: 'PE', value: 3100 }
  ]
  const points = [
    { id: 'sao-paulo', name: 'São Paulo', lat: -23.55, lon: -46.63, value: 18400, color: 2 },
    { id: 'buenos-aires', name: 'Buenos Aires', lat: -34.6, lon: -58.38, value: 4300, color: 2 }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <MapChart
    :regions="regions"
    :points="points"
    view="south-america"
    aria-label="Requests in South America"
  />
</template>
